cover: Technical debt: questions for your team

slides.title: What are you most nervous to change?
slides.body: And why? Ask for the part of the system, then for what makes changing it risky.

slides.title: What would you fix in two free weeks?
slides.body: The answer gives you a first repair to put a cost and a priority against.

slides.title: Which outside code is out of date?
slides.body: Ask which are no longer supported, and why their updates keep getting put off.

slides.title: Where does it change and break most?
slides.body: Start there. Debt in code nobody touches costs almost nothing. Debt in the checkout flow costs you every week.

slides.title: Do tests cover what it does today?
slides.body: Capture current behavior, including the odd parts people depend on, before anyone changes it.

slides.title: How long until a new engineer ships?
slides.body: If it takes months to ship a first useful change, that's a sign of debt.
